en-US.author: MuteMe LLC
en-US.description: The MuteMe companion application for your MuteMe
en-US.longDescription:
MuteMe is peripheral device used for those that engage in virtual meetings:
- MuteMe uses our patent-pending technology and is the first illuminated button to both control your microphone AND sync with the conference application tool of your choice.
- MuteMe lets you and others around you know when you are in a meeting and when you are muted/unmuted. This is ideal when working from home or when you get numerous interruptions.
- MuteMe allows you to customize your color selection for each status. We are keeping folks preferences and visual impairments in mind. Today, there are 8 color options (including LED off).
- MuteMe has numerous other features like sleep mode, brightness control, push-to-talk, push-to-mute, etc which make it the #1 tool ensuring you sound professional and are responsive when you want to be in virtual meetings.
en-US.name: MuteMe-Client
en-US.releaseNotes:
This is a feature release focused on MuteMe+ Dictation, improved meeting controls, software updates, and more reliable app and device shutdown. These changes cover updates since version 0.28.3.
#433 – NEW: MuteMe+ Dictation
Turn speech into text using your MuteMe button. Choose built-in dictation on Windows and macOS, or private, on-device Whisper transcription on supported Windows, macOS, and Linux systems. Includes guided setup, recording feedback, and automatic paste or clipboard delivery.
#64 & #221 – Slack Huddle Controls (macOS & Windows)
Added native Slack huddle support on macOS and restored Windows support, with microphone mute/unmute, camera synchronization, and more reliable recovery when Slack changes state.
#434 – macOS Teams Controls & Camera Status Fixes
Updated support for the latest Teams interface, with more reliable microphone and camera synchronization. Fixed camera indicators showing a change that the conferencing application did not accept.
#436 – macOS Zoom Microphone Detection
Fixed an issue where MuteMe could miss the microphone controls when joining a Zoom meeting, requiring a restart before mute synchronization worked.
#431 & #437 – Improved Microphone Detection (Windows & Linux)
Improved detection of active microphone use on Windows. Linux now handles paused recording streams and unavailable audio services more reliably.
#440 – NEW: Linux Software Updates
Supported Linux x64 DEB/RPM installations can now download and install updates directly through MuteMe. Existing Linux users need one manual upgrade to receive this feature.
#435 & #441 – Improved Software Update Experience
When automatic downloads are enabled, MuteMe downloads updates in the background and notifies you when they are ready, without forcing a restart. Manual update actions from Support show full release notes. A centered progress window shows download percentages and can be hidden, minimized, and reopened from Support. A short countdown appears before installation, with an Install Now option to skip the wait.
Small automatic update notifications close after 10 seconds when idle, and software and firmware update dialogs stay above the main app. Improved error reporting, retries, and reuse of verified downloads after installation failures. Linux can continue requesting administrator authorization for updates after an app restart.
#438 – Not in Meeting Actions Panel Fix
Fixed the settings panel opening automatically when Dictation was selected. It now stays collapsed until opened or setup is requested.
#439 – Linux Startup Fix
Corrected a startup issue that could cause the application window to crash on Linux.
#449 – Linux Shutdown Crash Fix
Fixed a Linux device-helper crash that could generate a crash report when quitting MuteMe. Device monitoring now finishes cleaning up before the helper process exits.
#450 – muteSync Lights and App Shutdown
Fixed muteSync lights remaining on after quitting MuteMe. The app now waits for the final lights-off commands and device cleanup before exiting. Shutdown also closes browser-extension connections and finishes saving pending settings and logs.
Update your software today to enjoy these improvements!

zh-CN.longDescription:
MuteMe 是一款专为参与虚拟会议人士设计的外接设备：
- MuteMe 采用我们正在申请专利的技术，是首款既能控制麦克风，又能与您选择的会议应用程序同步的发光按钮。
- MuteMe 可让您及周围的人清楚了解您是否正在会议中，以及您的麦克风是否静音/开启。这对于居家办公或经常被打扰的情况尤为理想。
- MuteMe 允许您为每种状态自定义颜色。我们充分考虑了用户的偏好和视觉障碍需求。目前提供 8 种颜色选项（包括关闭 LED 灯）。
- MuteMe 还具备多种其他功能，如睡眠模式、亮度调节、一键讲话、一键静音等，使其成为确保您在虚拟会议中声音专业且能按需响应的首选工具。
